summary: Comprehensive testing of Zubite.bg orthodontics quiz update. All 11 requested features tested and passed. Quiz flow: Intro → 8 questions → Result (3 score bands) → Lead form → Success. Scoring system working correctly with all three result paths verified.
passed_tests: Intro screen shows correct title 'Разберете дали ортодонтско лечение може да е подходящо за вас'
8 questions shown in sequence with proper navigation
Progress bar shows correct progress (X/8) format
Question 6 shows info text about price range before options
HIGH SCORE path (≥16 points) shows 'Добра новина' result with green styling
MEDIUM SCORE path (10-15 points) shows 'Възможно е...' result with amber styling
LOW SCORE path (<10 points) shows 'Нужна е по-точна оценка' result with blue styling
Lead form shows after result screen via 'Заяви обаждане' button
Lead form has Name, Phone (mandatory), City (Sofia/Plovdiv/Varna), Problem description (optional), Consent checkbox
Phone field validation works - error shown when empty
Consent checkbox validation works - error shown when unchecked
Lead submission works - API call successful
Back button works during quiz - returns to previous question
Back button from Q1 returns to intro screen
Form back button returns to result screen
critical_code_review_comments: OrthodonticsQuiz.tsx is well-structured with proper TypeScript types
Scoring system correctly implemented: ≥16 = strong, 10-15 = possible, <10 = needs_evaluation
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Lead form validation handles both phone and consent requirements
API integration with createLead works correctly
Priority calculation based on score and timing is implemented

Three score paths verified: HIGH (≥16) shows 'Добра новина', MEDIUM (10-15) shows 'Възможно е...', LOW (<10) shows 'Нужна е по-точна оценка'.
